item.title: CYBER CHIEF FIRED??? Trump Admin FIRES Cyber Chief During CYBER WAR | America First Ep. 1781
item.description:
Nicholas J. Fuentes discusses the White House firing its cyber security chief amid a week of major outages and incidents at Microsoft, Apple, JP Morgan Chase, the FAA and the NSA. He also covers the Trump–Vance tension, Rubio's rising odds, and the political mood on the right. The episode closes with Super Chats.

item.title: TRUMP AMNESTY DEAL??? Trump Revives DACA DEAL With Dems | America First Ep. 1776

He argues the move betrays the 2016 and 2024 deportation promises, questions why DHS stopped reporting deportation numbers, and says the MAGA movement is finished. He also covers new congressional subpoenas, a push to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth, and urges supporters to get involved in the GOP before taking super chats.
